{{Quote|They are an organization comprised by some of the most despicable individuals on Rori. They are being led by the evil Cobral Overlord, who is bent on the domination of this moon.|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac" />}}
The '''Cobral Overlord''' was a criminal leader who lived on the moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Overlord ruled the [[Neo-Cobral]],<ref name="SWG:ac" /> a criminal organization formed from the remnants of [[the Cobral]], a gang of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Black marketeer|dealers]] who once controlled the planet [[Frego]].<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref> The Cobral Overlord sought for the domination of Rori by the Neo-Cobrals.<ref name="SWG:ac" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cobral Overlord was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ac" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Cobral Overlord was mentioned during a conversation with a herald [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) and wad described as a unique individual leading the Neo-Cobrals. However, the rank of overlord was widely used among Neo-Cobrals in the game, as any other Neo-Cobral titles, since numerous "Neo-Cobral overlords" randomly spawned in Neo-Cobral camps, in the same fashion than other Neo-Cobral NPCs (Neo-Cobral bosses, Neo-Cobral bandits, Neo-Cobral runners...).<ref name="SWG:R">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Location: "Rori"}}</ref>
